method: Static source audit only; no external implementation execution or map reconstruction
source_result: Joint spatial/temperature/beta inverse-curvature matrices are calculated internally, but processed central marginal errors are returned; mosaic outputs interpolate these errors rather than exporting covariance.
normalisation: OBJCD is passed as dzeta; ETA and N_POST determine distinct prior/posterior scales multiplied by dzeta squared.
static_initialisation_concern: Allocated gamma0 has only diagonal assignments before its full inverse; this is a concern about this pinned implementation, with no established impact on archived Hi-GAL products.
next_evidence_required: Matching PSFs, band noise, occupation-to-column units and prior/posterior metadata
Validated central-block covariance propagation with marginal-output, fallback and mosaic consistency checks on the same frozen sightlines
decision: Insufficient release-bound integrated uncertainty: the primary comparison remains stopped. No automatic reconstruction or new experiment follows this audit.
